title: shey kehte they zainab se darbar mein jana hai
body:
shey kehte they zainab se darbar mein jana hai
….nana se kiya wada….
nana se kiya wada har haal nibhana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
1. hum aale payambar hain duniya ko batana hain
hyder ki khitabat ko phir yad dilana hain
darbar mein aye zainab… khudba bhi sunana hai
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. bhai ki nishani bhi kal khoon mein nahayegi aur laash bhi qasim ki khaime mein na ayegi
haan laash ke tukdon ko.. chun chun ke uthana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. hum laash-e-jawan lekar maqtal se jo aayenge
maqtal mein jo guzri hain laila ko sunayege
laasha ali akbar ka … laila ko dhikhana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. dariya se na lautega wo rashke qamar zainab
bhai ki judayee se tutegi kamar zainab
abbas-e-ali ka bhi….ab daagh uthana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. chut jayega karbal mein asghar sa pisar zainab
katjayega sine mein bano ka jigar zainab
ek qabr pasey qaima ….. asghar ki banana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
6. nana ke khazane ko karbal mein luta denge
ummat ke liye zainab hum sarko kata denge
karbal ki zameen zainab…..ab apna thikana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
7. seene pa mere dekho jab shumr-e-layeen hoga
gardan pa rawan meri jab khanjar-e-keen hoga
dekhe na meri bachi… manzar wo chupana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
8. chine gaye gohar bhi khoon rista hai kanon se
rukhsaar hain sub neele zalim ke tamachon se
ummat ke sitam sare ….nana ko sunana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
9. kamsin hain magar phir bhi har zulm wo sehlegi
zindan se na uthegi maiyat meri bachi ki
zinda mein sakina ka……ta hashr thikana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
10. kat jayega sab kunba jaljayega sab ghar bhi
bandhege rasan zalim chinjayegi chadar bhi
bazaron mein chehre ko…..balon se chupana hain
<<MINI>>
wada jo nibhana hain …… wada jo nibhana hain
<<DIVIDER>>
11. yeh hashmi sarwat ne roro ke likha nouha
kyun kar na padhe logo dil se yeh raza nouha
har haal mein insabka karbal mein thikana hain
<<MINI>>
